lines.problem: Somewhere, another holder wants the exact opposite trade. But you never meet. So everyone pays the pool.
lines.cost: On thin pools, a ten-thousand-dollar swap costs four point four percent. Sometimes, far more.
lines.home: Sama starts with the wallet you already have. Your tokenized stocks never leave it.
lines.target: Set the portfolio you want, once. Sama shows exactly how far you've drifted.
lines.ai: Or just say it. The built-in assistant turns one sentence into a target.
lines.ai2: Ask which Circle to join, and it finds the ones that fit your portfolio.
lines.circle: A Circle is a group of holders who rebalance together, round after round.
lines.join: Joining takes one free signature. Nothing moves yet.
lines.match: Then Sama finds the trades that cancel out. Pairs, or loops of three or more wallets.
lines.paired: Here, eighty-two percent of my rebalance matched. No pool. No slippage.
lines.settle: Everyone approves the exact plan. Then one atomic transaction settles every transfer, wallet to wallet.
lines.leftover: Whatever didn't match rolls into the next round, or swaps on PancakeSwap, only if it's cheap enough.
lines.proof: Live on BNB Chain. Verified, and checked after every round.
